conclusion.precondition: compatible masks, typed signed bound, and (lowerBound <= 0 or may-sign-bit = 0)
conclusion.theorem: For every feasible mask/nonzero word x >= lowerBound, the source result R satisfies lowerBound <= R <= x. For empty carriers R >= lowerBound still follows from the exact final source guard.
conclusion.consequence: Replacing only the lower bound by R preserves the complete joint word carrier for every additional upper bound.
conclusion.precision: The source helper may return a bound below the exact minimum; no standalone exact-minimum theorem is claimed.
conclusion.scope: All positive mathematical widths for the semantic lift; native Java widths 1..64, with production widths 1,8,16,32,64.

trust_boundary: Restricted source bridge, native mask/CodeUtil and least-positive-word lemmas, finite induction kernel, Python runtime. No formally verified Java compiler or proof-assistant claim.
